Leave unselected OTEL-002 unchanged. Write canonical ./service/.observe/otel-instrumentation.json, retain ./service/.observe/otel-instrumentation.md as the compatibility report, and render separate ./service/.observe/otel-instrumentation.html without adding implementation state to ./service/.observe/otel.html.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for resulting files when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Confirms target process, runtime shape, service.name source, and deployment.environment.name source or explicit absence before editing.
Initializes the SDK exactly once and sets tracer provider and text map propagator.
Uses route-aware, low-cardinality HTTP spans and preserves chi routing behavior.
Keeps OTLP endpoint and service name configurable through environment variables.

Scopes custom and business instrumentation to approved OTEL-001: does not add unselected OTEL-002 task.created, OTEL-004 task.create, or other unapproved custom signals. The Go guide's standard runtime metrics baseline is allowed and is not a drive-by custom signal.

Writes canonical .observe/otel-selection.json preserving requested ID OTEL-001 separately from dependency-closed approved IDs, then writes bound .observe/otel-instrumentation.json that records selected finding ID OTEL-001, implementation status, changed signals, validation evidence, and verification handoff without rewriting the audit baseline.

Retains .observe/otel-instrumentation.md as the complete compatibility report, renders .observe/otel-instrumentation.html with one concise verification status and every selected finding's change and observability improvement, leaves .observe/otel.html audit-only, and runs otel-verify or records the exact blocker. With a bound verification overlay, detailed item/scenario proof and coverage come from that overlay. Without one, each finding's verification-not-run/not-proven placeholder satisfies the HTML proof and coverage requirement; detailed item/scenario proof is not required, the exact blocker may be recorded in Markdown and the final response, and instrumentation-phase harness or exporter tests stay separately labeled rather than being promoted to bound proof.
